title: Five Percent First
description:
A full cutover scared everyone last time. Tonight you ship **five percent first**.

Split traffic between stable and canary Deployments (Services / Ingress weights or selectors as the brief says), prove the canary is healthy, then cut over cleanly. Leaving both forever is not a cutover.

**Meant for:** Canary / blue-green cutover.

problemStatement.brief: Split traffic between stable and canary Guestbook Deployments, then cut over cleanly.
